journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics

articles.title_en: Optimal Vaccine Subsidies for Epidemic Diseases
articles.title_cn: 流行病的最优疫苗补贴
articles.abstract_en: We analyze optimal vaccine subsidies in a model integrating disease epidemiology into a market with rational economic agents. The focus is on an intensive vaccine campaign to quell an epidemic in the short run. Across a range of market structures, positive vaccine externalities and optimal subsidies peak for diseases that spread quickly, but not so quickly that everyone is driven to be vaccinated. We assess the practical relevance of this peak—as well as the existence of increasing social returns to vaccination and optimality of universal vaccination—in calibrations to the COVID-19 pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个将疾病流行病学整合到具有理性经济主体的市场中的模型中，分析了最优疫苗补贴。重点是短期内在密集的疫苗运动中平息流行病。在一系列市场结构中，正疫苗外部性和最优补贴在传播迅速的疾病中达到峰值，但并非快到每个人都被迫接种疫苗。我们在针对COVID-19大流行的校准中评估了这一峰值的实际相关性，以及疫苗接种的社会回报递增和全民疫苗接种的最优性的存在。

articles.title_en: London Fog: A Century of Pollution and Mortality, 1866–1965
articles.title_cn: 伦敦雾：一个世纪的污染与死亡率，1866-1965
articles.abstract_en: This study draws on London’s long experience with air pollution in order to improve our understanding of the overall effects of pollution exposure and how and why these effects evolve as locations develop. I compare uniquely detailed new mortality data covering 1866 to 1965 to the timing of London’s famous fog events, which trapped emissions in the city. I show that air pollution was a major contributor to mortality in London over this period and that it interacted strongly with specific infectious diseases. As a consequence of this interaction, reductions in the infectious disease burden substantially altered the health costs of pollution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用伦敦长期以来的空气污染经验，以提高我们对污染暴露总体影响及其如何随地点发展而演变的理解。我将1866年至1965年间独特详细的新死亡率数据与伦敦著名的雾事件时间进行对比，这些雾事件将排放物困在城市中。我表明，在此期间，空气污染是伦敦死亡率的主要贡献因素，并且与特定传染病有强烈交互作用。由于这种交互作用，传染病负担的减少显著改变了污染的健康成本。

articles.title_en: Hospital Allocation and Racial Disparities in Health Care
articles.title_cn: 医院分配与医疗保健中的种族差异
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework to measure the role of hospital allocation in racial disparities in health care and use it to study Black and white heart attack patients. Black patients receive care at lower-performing hospitals than white patients. However, over two decades, the performance gap between hospitals treating Black and white patients shrank by over two-thirds. This progress is due to more rapid performance improvement at hospitals that tended to treat Black patients rather than reallocation of patients. Hospital improvement is correlated with adoption of a productivity-raising input, beta blockers. Our work highlights reallocation and performance improvement as future disparity-reduction levers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架来衡量医院分配在医疗保健种族差异中的作用，并用它来研究黑人和白人心脏病发作患者。黑人患者接受的医院护理水平低于白人患者。然而，在二十多年的时间里，治疗黑人和白人患者的医院之间的绩效差距缩小了三分之二以上。这一进展归因于倾向于治疗黑人患者的医院绩效改善更快，而非患者重新分配。医院改善与采用提高生产力的投入——β受体阻滞剂——相关。我们的工作强调重新分配和绩效改善是未来减少差异的杠杆。

articles.title_en: Alcohol, Violence, and Injury-Induced Mortality: Evidence from a Modern-Day Prohibition
articles.title_cn: 酒精、暴力与伤害导致的死亡率：来自现代禁酒令的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the impact of a sudden and unexpected nationwide alcohol sales ban in South Africa. We find that this policy causally reduced injury-induced mortality in the country by at least 14%. We argue that this estimate constitutes a lower bound on the true impact of alcohol on injury-induced mortality. We also document a sharp drop in violent crimes, indicating a tight link between alcohol and aggressive behavior in society. Our results underscore the severe harm that alcohol can cause and point toward a role for policy measures that target the heaviest drinkers in society.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了南非一项突然且出乎意料的全国性酒精销售禁令的影响。我们发现，该政策使该国的伤害导致的死亡率至少降低了14%。我们认为，这一估计构成了酒精对伤害导致的死亡率真实影响的下限。我们还记录了暴力犯罪的急剧下降，表明酒精与社会中的攻击性行为之间存在紧密联系。我们的结果强调了酒精可能造成的严重危害，并指出了针对社会中重度饮酒者的政策措施的作用。

articles.title_en: The Effect of Incarceration on Mortality
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the effect of incarceration on mortality using administrative data from Ohio between 1992 and 2017. We first document that long-run survival is higher among the incarcerated than similar nonincarcerated defendants. Using event study designs centered around the time of release, we show why: mortality risk halves during the period of incarceration, with large reductions in murders, overdoses, and natural causes of death. However, incarceration does not increase postrelease mortality, and so the overall effect is increased longevity. These estimates reflect the high-risk environment faced by defendants when not incarcerated and suggest noncarceral policies to reduce these risks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用俄亥俄州1992年至2017年间的行政数据，分析了监禁对死亡率的影响。我们首先记录了在押人员与未入狱的类似被告相比，长期生存率更高。通过围绕释放时间设计的事件研究，我们揭示了原因：监禁期间死亡风险减半，谋杀、药物过量和自然原因导致的死亡大幅减少。然而，监禁并未增加释放后的死亡率，因此总体效果是寿命延长。这些估计反映了被告在未入狱时所面临的高风险环境，并提出了减少这些风险的非监禁政策建议。

articles.title_en: A Year Older, A Year Wiser (and Farther from Frontier): Invention Rents and Human Capital Depreciation
articles.title_cn: 年长一岁，智慧一分（且离前沿更远）：发明租金与人力资本折旧
articles.abstract_en: We look at how the arrival of an invention affects wage returns and the probability of moving out of employment for white- and blue-collar co-workers of the inventor. First results suggest that older workers are hurt by the arrival of an invention. This negative effect disappears when we control for education and, in particular, for the time since obtaining the last formal degree, that is, distance to human capital frontier. If anything, this effect is slightly higher for non-STEM than STEM-educated co-workers. This result suggests that retraining programs could be helpful in making the process of creative destruction and economic growth more inclusive.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了发明的出现如何影响发明者的白领和蓝领同事的工资回报以及退出就业的概率。初步结果表明，年长工人受到发明出现的负面影响。当我们控制教育，特别是自获得最后一个正式学位以来的时间（即与人力资本前沿的距离）后，这种负面影响消失。如果有什么不同的话，这种影响对非STEM教育的同事略高于STEM教育的同事。这一结果表明，再培训计划可能有助于使创造性破坏和经济增长的过程更具包容性。

articles.title_en: Children’s Sleep and Human Capital Production
articles.title_cn: 儿童睡眠与人力资本生产
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses exogenous variation in sleep induced by sunset time to present the first human capital estimates of (i) the effects of child sleep from the developing world and (ii) the long-run effects of child sleep in any context. Later sunset reduces children’s sleep: when the sun sets later, children go to bed later but fail to compensate by waking up later. Sleep-deprived children study less and increase nap time and indoor leisure activities. Short-run sleep loss decreases children’s test scores. Chronic sleep deficits translate into fewer years of education and lower primary and middle school completion rates among school-age children.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用日落时间引起的睡眠外生变化，首次提供了（i）发展中国家儿童睡眠影响的人力资本估计，以及（ii）任何情境下儿童睡眠长期影响的人力资本估计。日落时间较晚会减少儿童的睡眠：当太阳落山较晚时，儿童上床睡觉的时间较晚，但未能通过晚起来弥补。睡眠不足的儿童学习时间减少，午睡时间和室内休闲活动增加。短期睡眠损失会降低儿童的考试成绩。长期睡眠不足会转化为受教育年限减少，以及学龄儿童小学和初中完成率降低。

articles.title_en: Fireside Chats: Communication and Consumers’ Expectations in the Great Depression
articles.title_cn: 炉边谈话：大萧条时期的沟通与消费者预期
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows how policy announcements can be used to manage expectations. Using regional variation in radio exposure, I evaluate the impact of FDR’s 1935 Fireside Chat, in which he showcased the introduction of important social policies, establishing a new expansionary cycle of the New Deal. I document that cities with higher exposure to the announcement exhibited a significant increase in spending on durable goods. The estimated effect is consistent with changes in expectations in line with the policies announced. This paper shows the power of communication as a policy tool.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文展示了政策公告如何被用来管理预期。利用广播覆盖率的地区差异，我评估了罗斯福总统1935年炉边谈话的影响，在那次谈话中，他展示了重要社会政策的引入，确立了新政的新一轮扩张周期。我记录到，接触该公告较多的城市在耐用品支出上表现出显著增长。估计效应与所宣布政策带来的预期变化一致。本文展示了沟通作为政策工具的力量。

articles.title_en: Monetary Policy, Markup Dispersion, and Aggregate TFP
articles.title_cn: 货币政策、加成率分散与总量TFP
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of markup dispersion and aggregate TFP for monetary transmission. Empirically, we show that the response of markup dispersion to monetary policy shocks can account for a significant fraction of the aggregate TFP response in the first two years after the shock. Analytically, we show that heterogeneous price rigidity can explain the response of markup dispersion if firms have a precautionary price-setting motive, which is present in common New Keynesian environments. We provide empirical evidence in support of this explanation. Finally, we study the mechanism and its implications in a quantitative model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究加成率分散和总量TFP在货币政策传导中的作用。在实证上，我们表明加成率分散对货币政策冲击的响应可以解释冲击后头两年总量TFP响应的显著部分。在分析上，我们表明如果企业具有预防性定价动机，异质性价格粘性可以解释加成率分散的响应，而这一动机在常见的新凯恩斯环境中存在。我们提供了支持这一解释的实证证据。最后，我们在一个定量模型中研究该机制及其含义。

articles.title_en: A Structural Investigation of Quantitative Easing
articles.title_cn: 量化宽松的结构性研究
articles.abstract_en: Using nonlinear Bayesian methods that fully account for the binding zero lower bound (ZLB), we estimate a large-scale macrofinance DSGE model on U.S. data. Counterfactual analysis suggests that by easing financing conditions, quantitative easing facilitated a net increase in aggregate investment. The resulting expansion of firms’ production capacities lowered their marginal costs. These disinflationary supply side effects dominated over the inflationary effects induced by the stimulus to aggregate demand. At the ZLB, the concomitant rise in real interest rates, in turn, induced a net fall in aggregate consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用充分考虑零利率下限约束的非线性贝叶斯方法，我们基于美国数据估计了一个大规模宏观金融DSGE模型。反事实分析表明，通过缓解融资条件，量化宽松促进了总投资的净增长。由此带来的企业生产能力的扩张降低了其边际成本。这些通缩性的供给侧效应主导了由总需求刺激引发的通胀效应。在零利率下限约束下，随之而来的实际利率上升反过来又导致了总消费的净下降。

articles.title_en: The Evolution of Technological Substitution in Low-Wage Labor Markets
articles.title_cn: 低工资劳动力市场中技术替代的演变
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses minimum wage hikes to evaluate the susceptibility of low-wage employment to technological substitution. We find that automation is accelerating and supplanting a broader set of low-wage routine jobs since the 2008–2009 financial crisis. Simultaneously, low-wage interpersonal jobs are increasing and offsetting routine job loss. However, interpersonal job growth does not appear to be enough, as it was prior to the financial crisis, to fully offset the negative effects of automation on low-wage routine jobs. Employment losses are most evident among non-Asian people of color who experience outsized losses at routine jobs and smaller gains at interpersonal jobs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用最低工资上调来评估低工资就业对技术替代的敏感性。我们发现，自2008-2009年金融危机以来，自动化正在加速并取代更广泛的低工资常规性工作。与此同时，低工资人际交往型工作正在增加，抵消了常规性工作的损失。然而，人际交往型工作的增长似乎不足以像金融危机前那样完全抵消自动化对低工资常规性工作的负面影响。就业损失在非亚裔有色人种中最为明显，他们在常规性工作中遭受的损失过大，而在人际交往型工作中获得的收益较小。

articles.title_en: Exporting, Abatement, and Firm-Level Emissions: Evidence from China’s Accession to the WTO
articles.title_cn: 出口、减排与企业层面排放：来自中国加入WTO的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the joint impact of exporting and abatement on the environmental performance of Chinese manufacturers. For two common air pollutants (SO2 and industrial dust) we document that (a) exporters are significantly less emissions-intensive relative to their nonexporting counterparts and (b) this difference cannot be explained by differential rates of abatement alone. Employing variation in trade and environmental conditions across time and space, we quantify the impact of endogenous export and abatement decisions on firm-level emissions. We find that exporting reduces emissions by at least 36% across pollutants. We explore underlying determinants of export-driven reductions in emissions intensity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了出口与减排对中国制造商环境绩效的联合影响。对于两种常见的空气污染物（二氧化硫和工业粉尘），我们记录了以下事实：（a）出口商的排放强度显著低于非出口商；（b）这一差异不能仅由减排率的差异来解释。利用贸易和环境条件在时间和空间上的变化，我们量化了内生出口和减排决策对企业层面排放的影响。我们发现，出口使各污染物的排放至少减少36%。我们探讨了出口驱动排放强度下降的潜在决定因素。

articles.title_en: The Effects of Transit Systems on International Trade
articles.title_cn: 过境系统对国际贸易的影响
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we estimate the trade effects of a transit system upgrading that streamlines border processing in developing countries. Our empirical approach combines transaction-level export data from El Salvador with unique data that distinguishes export flows that were processed on the transit system. Our results indicate that the new transit system lowered regulatory border costs and raised exports. At the low end, our back-of-the-envelope estimate of the return to investment is US$ 3-to-1. This evidence informs a policy covered by the 2013 WTO Agreement of Trade Facilitation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们评估了简化发展中国家边境处理的过境系统升级的贸易影响。我们的实证方法将萨尔瓦多的交易级出口数据与区分在过境系统处理的出口流量的独特数据相结合。我们的结果表明，新的过境系统降低了监管边境成本并增加了出口。在低端，我们对投资回报的粗略估计为 3 至 1 美元。该证据为 2013 世贸组织贸易便利化协议所涵盖的政策提供了依据。

articles.title_en: A Canonical Representation of Block Matrices with Applications to Covariance and Correlation Matrices
articles.title_cn: 块矩阵的规范表示及其在协方差和相关性矩阵中的应用
articles.abstract_en: We obtain a canonical representation for block matrices. The representation facilitates simple computation of the determinant, the matrix inverse, and other powers of a block matrix, as well as the matrix logarithm and the matrix exponential. These results are particularly useful for block covariance and block correlation matrices, where evaluation of the Gaussian log-likelihood and estimation are greatly simplified. We illustrate this with an empirical application using a large panel of daily asset returns. Moreover, the representation paves new ways to model and regularize large covariance/correlation matrices, test block structures in matrices, and estimate regressions with many variables.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们获得了块矩阵的规范表示。该表示简化了块矩阵的行列式、矩阵逆及其他幂次的计算，以及矩阵对数和矩阵指数的计算。这些结果对于块协方差和块相关矩阵特别有用，其中高斯对数似然的评估和估计被大大简化。我们通过一个使用大型日资产收益面板的实证应用来说明这一点。此外，该表示为建模和正则化大型协方差/相关矩阵、检验矩阵中的块结构以及估计具有许多变量的回归开辟了新的途径。

articles.title_en: Reading the Candlesticks: An OK Estimator for Volatility
articles.title_cn: 解读K线图：波动率的最优K线估计量
articles.abstract_en: We propose an Optimal candlesticK (OK) estimator for the spot volatility using high-frequency candlestick observations. Under a standard infill asymptotic setting, we show that the OK estimator is asymptotically unbiased and has minimal asymptotic variance within a class of linear estimators. Its estimation error can be coupled by a Brownian functional, which permits valid inference. Our theoretical and numerical results suggest that the proposed candlestick-based estimator is much more accurate than the conventional spot volatility estimator based on high-frequency returns. An empirical illustration documents the intraday volatility dynamics of various assets during the Fed chairman’s recent congressional testimony.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种利用高频K线观测数据估计瞬时波动率的最优K线（OK）估计量。在标准的填充渐近设定下，我们证明OK估计量是渐近无偏的，并且在一类线性估计量中具有最小的渐近方差。其估计误差可以通过布朗泛函耦合，从而允许有效的推断。我们的理论和数值结果表明，所提出的基于K线的估计量比基于高频收益的传统瞬时波动率估计量要准确得多。一个实证示例记录了美联储主席近期在国会作证期间各种资产的日内波动率动态。

articles.title_en: Do Universities Improve Local Economic Resilience?
articles.title_cn: 大学是否提升了地方经济韧性？
articles.abstract_en: We use a novel identification strategy to investigate whether regional universities make their local economies more resilient. Our strategy is based on state governments using similar site-selection criteria to assign normal schools (to train teachers) and insane asylums between 1830 and 1930. Normal schools became larger regional universities while asylum properties mostly continue as small state-owned psychiatric health facilities. We find that a regional university roughly offsets the negative effects of manufacturing exposure. We show the resilience of regional public university spending is an important mechanism, and we show correlations consistent with bachelor’s degree share also playing a mediating role.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们采用一种新颖的识别策略来研究区域性大学是否使其地方经济更具韧性。我们的策略基于州政府在1830年至1930年间使用相似的选址标准来分配师范学校（用于培训教师）和精神病院。师范学校后来发展成为规模更大的区域性大学，而精神病院的地产大多继续作为小型的州立精神卫生设施。我们发现，一所区域性大学大致抵消了制造业暴露的负面影响。我们表明，区域性公立大学支出的韧性是一个重要机制，并且我们展示的相关系数与学士学位占比也发挥中介作用这一观点一致。

articles.title_en: Higher Education and Local Educational Attainment: Evidence from the Establishment of U.S. Colleges
articles.title_cn: 高等教育与地方教育获得：来自美国大学建立的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how the presence of a college affects local educational attainment. As counterfactuals for current college locations, we use historical “runner-up” locations that were strongly considered to become college sites but were ultimately not chosen. We find that winning counties today have college degree attainment rates 56% higher than runner-up counties and more private-sector employment in human-capital-intensive industries. These effects are not driven primarily by recent in-migration of educated adults, and alternative public investments did not have similar effects on local educational attainment. The results indicate that colleges played an important role in shaping long-run local outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了一所大学的存在如何影响地方教育获得。作为当前大学选址的反事实，我们使用历史上曾被强烈考虑作为大学校址但最终未被选中的“次优”地点。我们发现，如今胜出的县拥有大学学位获得率比次优县高56%，并且在人力资本密集型行业中有更多的私营部门就业。这些效应并非主要由近期受过教育的成年人迁入所驱动，而且替代性公共投资对地方教育获得没有类似的影响。结果表明，大学在塑造长期地方结果方面发挥了重要作用。

articles.abstract_en: We evaluate a Danish reform focused on improving language training for those granted refugee status on or after January 1, 1999. Using a Regression Discontinuity Design, we find a significant, permanent, positive effect on earnings. This effect emerged after completion of language classes and was accompanied by additional schooling and a higher probability of working in complex jobs, consistent with language training, rather than other minor aspects of the reform, producing the results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了一项丹麦改革，该改革旨在改善在1999年一月1日或之后获得难民身份者的语言培训。使用断点回归设计，我们发现对收入产生了显著、持久且正向的影响。这一影响在完成语言课程后显现，并伴随着额外的教育机会和从事复杂工作的更高概率，这与语言培训而非改革的其他次要方面产生这些结果相一致。
